research.edition: international Twelve Data REST API at api.twelvedata.com
research.searchCoverage: Official Twelve Data REST API at https://api.twelvedata.com authenticates with Authorization: apikey <key> (query apikey also documented). Reference catalog GETs /exchanges, /stocks, /forex_pairs and fundamentals GET /profile were confirmed. Operator is Twelve Data Pte. Ltd. in Singapore; the product is a global market-data API, not a mainland-China edition. Pinned credential validator uses billable GET /price?symbol=AAPL; native healthcheck uses GET /exchanges. HTTP 200 bodies may carry code/message/status=error; native bodyErrorPaths uses code and message because status ok would trip a string path. Dated incident search on 2026-09-13 found no qualifying compromise. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to GET /exchanges, a documented reference catalog, instead of the pinned validator GET /price?symbol=AAPL which is a billable quote.
Authorization sends the documented apikey prefix. Query apikey is omitted.
HTTP 200 bodies with numeric code or message are treated as failures via bodyErrorPaths. status is not used because success status ok is a non-empty string.
Native category is banking-data; source Finance/Data are not in Rust CATEGORIES.
Returns raw Twelve Data JSON under data rather than the upstream normalized catalog wrapper.
GET /exchanges with optional type, name, code, and country query names from pinned source and official docs.
show_plan is omitted.
Returns raw Twelve Data JSON under data.
GET /stocks with optional symbol, exchange, country, and type query names matching official reference docs.
figi, isin, cusip, cik, show_plan, and include_delisted from pinned source are omitted.
Returns raw Twelve Data JSON under data.
GET /forex_pairs with optional symbol, currency_base, and currency_quote. Native input names currencyBase and currencyQuote map to the official snake_case query names.
Returns raw Twelve Data JSON under data.
GET /profile requires symbol. Pinned source accepts any of symbol, figi, isin, or cusip; native templates cannot express at-least-one-of, so symbol is required and figi/isin/cusip are omitted.
Optional exchange, mic_code, and country query names match pinned source.
Returns raw Twelve Data JSON under data rather than the upstream camelCased profile object.
Official GET /symbol_search. show_plan is omitted.
Official GET /price. Native requires symbol because at-least-one-of symbol/figi/isin/cusip cannot be expressed.
Official GET /quote. Native requires symbol.
Official GET /eod. Native requires symbol.
Official GET /time_series. Native requires symbol and interval.
Official GET /market_state returns a JSON array, so native data is an array.
Official GET /earliest_timestamp. Native requires symbol and interval.
Official GET /market_movers/{market}. Native uses a path segment for the required market family.
Official GET /etfs catalog. Native reuses the stocks catalog HTTP shape.
Official GET /cryptocurrencies. Native input names currencyBase and currencyQuote map to snake_case query names.
Official GET /statistics. Native requires symbol.
Official GET /dividends. Native requires symbol.
Official GET /splits. Native requires symbol.
Official GET /earnings. Native requires symbol.
Official GET /rsi. Native requires symbol and interval. time_period maps from timePeriod.
